cited.quote: salt production, silver anklet & silver lamp making, brass articles, vessels making Industries, lock and silk based industries may be categorised as

rationale: C3 is a GO (2021-10-22) accepting the proposal to categorise salt, silver anklet and lamp, brass and vessel making as Traditional Industries under the thrust sector, eligible for Special Capital Subsidy, which gives them special status and support for production. Label differs from 'cottage industries' but substance matches.

cited.quote: this Government has decided to reduce the effective rate of tax on petrol by Rs.3 per litre

rationale: C2 is a budget speech announcing a Rs.3 per litre petrol tax cut; no GO or notification is shown, and nothing on diesel. A budget announcement is not operationalisation. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: Quality of teaching in Government schools and learning outcomes will now be accorded the highest priority

rationale: C1-C3 discuss improving school quality statewide in policy note and budget speech terms; none mentions Manappadu, Alanthalai or Kallamozhi or a dedicated measure for coastal schools. Only general statements.
C1-C5 concern disciplinary cases of staff, AEFI guidelines, university audit and promotion procedures; none is about cases against journalists.

cited.quote: A mobile outreach vehicle to be hired with branding as per prescribed norms from National Health Mission
CAPD support services shall be provided at the doorstep following a Hub and Spoke Model

rationale: C5/C2 are GO 340 (2021-08-03) implementing Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam: doorstep health services by field teams with mobile outreach vehicles at block level. This provides mobile medical access to communities but is not clearly a mobile hospital; partial match.
C1-C5 cover RTI officer allotments, e-Office in Secretariat, textile posts and IT policy; none is about computer operators for MLA offices.

cited.quote: as matching State share for implementation of Sericulture welfare schemes (Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan)
establishment of Automatic Silk Reeling Machine (ARM) unit (400 ends)

rationale: C1/C2 are GO 59 (2021-05-26) sanctioning the State share for subsidised components (65:25:10) including support for establishing an Automatic Silk Reeling Machine unit, i.e. silk yarn production. A dedicated subsidised measure, though small and under a central scheme.
C1-C2 discuss agricultural connections, billing apps and electrical inspectorate; C3-C5 are unrelated. None concerns the three-phase charge levied with electricity bills.
C1-C5 concern committees for Covid orphans, promotions, Covid deaths, NEET and DISHA; none is about a committee on forming new districts.
C1-C5 concern sugarcane production, cane prices and sugar mills; none is about additional sugar supplied at ration shops.

cited.quote: Value added products for millets will enable the farmers to become agri-entrepreneurs

rationale: C2/C3 sanction research and demonstrations on dryland crops and millets, not cash incentives to farmers. C4/C5 are other schemes. No step for the promised incentive.

cited.quote: This Government will also ensure that the 42 authority of the State Governments to determine the backwardness

rationale: C4 (Governor's address) states intent on States' authority over backwardness but shows no formal step urging a constitutional amendment. C1/C2 implement a state Act in force before office; C3/C5 are sports quota. No advocacy step shown.

cited.quote: the State Government has proposed to come up with a Sustainable Mining Policy for the State

rationale: C2 only proposes a sustainable mining policy; C1 describes existing exploration; C3 is a budget statement on revenue. No policy or framework on rare minerals has been issued.

cited.quote: Measures will be taken up for the improvement of roads and bridges
earmarked for drinking water, rainwater harvesting and water recycling

rationale: C1 releases routine Finance Commission grants to all rural local bodies; C2 is a budget statement on rural roads. Neither is a step targeted at remote, hill-top villages and hamlets.
C1-C5 concern road sector projects, a bus stand audit, BharatNet and soil conservation; none is about the minibus project.

cited.quote: Singara Chennai 2.0 will be launched with an emphasis on clean and green Chennai with every household receiving a water tap connection
Ensuring supply of drinking water to each house directly in both urban and rural areas will be the highest priority of this Government

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) and C2 (budget speech) state intent to provide household water connections in Chennai; no GO, tender or launched scheme for piped water in corporation areas is shown.

cited.quote: 5 substations have been 51 finalized for establishment of solar power plants of 50 MW capacity
To reduce costs, renewable energy will be developed and integrated at the distribution level

rationale: C1 reports a pilot solarisation project with substations finalised for 50 MW solar plants, a preparatory step; C3 is budget intent. C4/C5 fund standalone solar pumps, a neighbouring subject. No operational addition toward 20,000 MW shown.

cited.quote: a total sum of Rs.303.66 crore has been provided for fishing ban period relief assistance

rationale: C1 is a budget provision for fishing ban relief with no amount per fisherman and no increase from Rs 5000 to Rs 6000; other extracts are unrelated. No official step shown.

cited.quote: This Government will urge the Union Government to advise the Government of Sri Lanka to ensure that Eelam Tamils have equal civil and political rights

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) is a statement of intent to urge the Union; no resolution, letter or other formal step is shown, and no mention of a referendum. Other extracts unrelated.

cited.quote: Chennai Metro Flood Management Committee, comprising experts in environment, urban planning, disaster management, will be established to devise flood control methods

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) only says the committee will be established; no GO constituting it is shown. C2/C3 (urban employment), C4 (climate missions) and C5 (highway flood restoration) are related but not this committee.
